title: Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks: Curse of Dimensionality and Structural Bias
abstract: arXiv:2610.21480v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Kolmogorov-Arnold networks (KANs) have a dimension-independent approximation exponent when the target admits a sufficiently smooth representation by univariate edge functions. We ask whether this favorable scaling belongs to the architecture or to the assumed target class. For arbitrary-depth standard spline-KANs, we prove a worst-case lower bound on isotropic Sobolev balls: below a dimension-independent accuracy threshold, the required number of spline coefficients grows at least exponentially with input dimension. Existing composition-matched MLP results, by contrast, show that favorable exponents on low-arity targets are not exclusive to KANs. We also revisit empirical comparisons. On four scaling-law targets, spline-KAN approximants constructed from known decompositions transfer exactly to MLPs with the cubic ReLU activation $\sigma(x)=(\max\{0,x\})^3$, although their full dense parameter counts are larger. translated_title: Kolmogorov-Arnold 网络：维度灾难与结构性偏置
translated_abstract: 当目标函数能够通过足够光滑的单变量边函数进行表示时，Kolmogorov-Arnold 网络（KAN）具有与维度无关的逼近指数。我们探讨这种良好的标度特性究竟属于网络架构本身，还是属于所假设的目标函数类。对于任意深度的标准样条-KAN，我们在各向同性 Sobolev 球上证明了最坏情形下界：当精度低于某个与维度无关的阈值时，所需的样条系数数量至少随输入维度呈指数增长。相比之下，现有的与组合结构相匹配的 MLP 结果表明，在低元数目标上取得良好逼近指数并非 KAN 所独有。我们还重新审视了实证比较：在四个标度律目标上，由已知分解构造的样条-KAN 逼近器可以精确转换为采用三次 ReLU 激活函数 σ(x)=(max{0,x})³ 的 MLP，尽管后者的完整稠密参数量更大。在受控的岭剖面实验中……
tldr: 该论文证明了标准样条-KAN 在最坏情形下仍受维度灾难制约——所需样条系数数量随输入维度指数增长，表明 KAN 的维度无关逼近优势源于对目标函数类的假设而非架构本身，且 KAN 逼近器可精确等价转换为三次 ReLU 激活的 MLP。
en_tdlr: The paper proves that standard spline-KANs suffer from the curse of dimensionality in the worst case—requiring exponentially many spline coefficients in input dimension—showing that their dimension-independent approximation advantage stems from assumptions on the target class rather than the architecture, and that spline-KAN approximants transfer exactly to MLPs with cubic ReLU activation.
